question:
How many planets are not sun?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905238db703d96804925de8e7768692e346f53c37ed27537f7cefa6c73136fde.png]
solution:
The Venn diagram is given below:-

The rectangle represents Sun,

The circle represents Pen.

The triangle represents Planet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac2408d1673864c2cf5d4fcc6cb3ba4f02e025e5625f188205e5b2aeeb6cc736.png] 

The planets that are not sun = 4 + 8 = 12.

Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer.
